answer: Someone running 133 aliases hence needs 31 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in zenith, expire in vertex, and inlet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1926 identities would post 4213 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
